```{=html}
<div style="text-align: right; margin-bottom: 1em; position: relative; display: inline-block; font-size:0.8em;">
  <button id="langButton" onclick="toggleDropdown()" style="padding:4px 8px; font-size:0.8em; width:125px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;">
    Version in English ▼
  </button>
  <ul id="langDropdown" style="display:none; list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; position:absolute; right:0; background:#fff; border:1px solid #ccc; z-index:1000; width:125px;">
    <li id="lang-en" style="padding:4px 8px; cursor:pointer; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:0.8em;" onclick="window.location.href='index.html'">
     English
    </li>
    <li id="lang-es" style="padding:4px 8px; cursor:pointer; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:0.8em;" onclick="window.location.href='index-es.html'">
     Español
    </li>
  </ul>
</div>

<style>
.selected-lang {
  background-color: #f2f0e8; 
  font-weight: bold;
}
</style>

<script>
function toggleDropdown() {
  const dropdown = document.getElementById("langDropdown");
  dropdown.style.display = (dropdown.style.display === "block") ? "none" : "block";
}

window.onclick = function(event) {
  if (!event.target.matches('button')) {
    const dropdown = document.getElementById("langDropdown");
    if (dropdown.style.display === "block") {
      dropdown.style.display = "none";
    }
  }
}

const langButton = document.getElementById("langButton");
const enOption = document.getElementById("lang-en");
const esOption = document.getElementById("lang-es");

if (window.location.href.includes("index-es.html")) {
  langButton.innerHTML = 'Versión en Español ▼';
  esOption.classList.add("selected-lang");
} else {
  langButton.innerHTML = 'Version in English ▼';
  enOption.classList.add("selected-lang");
}
</script>

```
